system.description: Using a subject's birth date and the Tonalamatl (the Aztec Book of Destinies), the Necromancer divines the subject's day sign. Cast on a living or undead target, a success grants one free retest in the caster's next challenge against that individual. Cast on a wraith, it grants the equivalent of holding one of that wraith's fetters for the caster's next use of Necromancy against it. The effect does not stack and cannot be reapplied until the earlier retest or fetter-equivalent has been used.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
